raw_segments.text: Yes, thought so, sloping into the empire. Gone, plain soda would do him good.
Where Pat Kinsella had his harp theatre before Whitbread ran the Queen's.
Broth of a boy, Dion Bousicault business with his harvest moon face in a pokey bonnet.
Three purdy maids from school. How time flies, eh? Showing long red pantaloons
under his skirts. Drinkers, drinking, laughed spluttering their
drink against their breath. More power, Pat course-read.
Fun for drunkards, guffaw and smoke. Take off that white hat.
His parboiled eyes. Where is he now? Beggar somewhere. The harp that once did starve us all.
